consequence.statement: Certificates with RSA 3072/4096 keys will use SHA-384/SHA-512 hashes; widely supported and not expected to be an issue, but errors may appear as larger RSA keys rotate.

assertion.statement: RSA certificates with 3072- or 4096-bit keys are now signed with SHA-384 or SHA-512 respectively; this may cause errors with peers that don't support these hashes as keys rotate.
